title: debounce-credential-refresh-and-introduce-lightweight-stream-facade-across-sdks
author: Sana Reddy
release_notes: Backpressure: Introduced debounce for token refresh across SDKs to reduce auth thrash during high churn. Added compact stream facade to Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs with minimal ergonomic helpers and documented migration guide. Bumped TS v to 2.8.0, Py SDK to 1.9.1, Go SDK to v1.6.0.
description: Context: We observed auth churn and repeated credential refresh storms when many concurrent streams reached credential expiry around the same time (incident SUP-1182). This produced transient 401 spikes and request retries which amplified load. Motivation: reduce tail latency and unnecessary token refresh traffic while keeping SDK consumer API lightweight and familiar. Changes in this PR: 1) Introduce a cross-SDK debounce mechanism for credential refreshes (configurable 'refresh_debounce_ms', default 2500ms). The debounce sits in the credential mediator layer and ensures a single refresh attempt per credential window plus jitter. 2) Add a compact, language-idiomatic stream facade (PullStreamLight / StreamHandleSlim) that wraps existing streaming primitives to provide: - simple pause/resume hooks - a cancel() method that cancels underlying RPC and drains buffers - an ergonomic async iterator / async generator adapter (TS/Py/Go idioms) 3) Unify retry preset names and semantics across SDKs (named presets: conservative, balanced, aggressive) and wire deterministic base/backoff windows used by the serving runtime telemetry team. 4) Add metrics hooks to emit cred_refresh.debounce_count and cred_refresh.suppressed_count so SRE can monitor suppression behavior. 5) Tests & examples: unit tests to validate debounce under synthetic clock; integration smoke tests in CI for streaming ergonomics; migration snippet in docs. Checklist: - [x] Implement debounce logic with feature flag - [x] Implement slim stream facade in TS/Py/Go - [x] Add telemetry counters and docs - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] Update SDK versions and changelogs - [x] Run CI, fix linting and type issues Notes and caveats: - Default debounce value chosen conservatively after internal load tests (2500ms) to avoid delaying urgent reauth in low-concurrency scenarios. It's configurable per-client or via global SDK config. - The facade is intentionally minimal; it does not change serialization or retry semantics by default. Consumers can opt-in to the retry preset via client config. - This PR intentionally does not change server-side token TTL behavior; coordination with serving runtime changes will follow in a separate deployment (ENG-2520). Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2431/debounce-credential-refresh-design, incident: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/SUP-1182
